title: One-week budget
summary: Plan a simple weekly budget with needs, wants, and a small save line.
objectives: Split money into needs, wants, and save
Make a plan that adds up
briefMarkdown:
## Mission

Imagine you can use **500** units this week (your coach may change the number to your local money).

Make three lines:
1. Needs
2. Wants
3. Save (even small)

Totals must not exceed 500.

quiz.prompt: Which belongs in Needs for most students?
quiz.teachBack: Needs keep school/life running. Wants are optional extras.

projectPrompt: Write your 3-line budget with numbers that add up. One sentence: what you will save for.
successCriteria: Numbers do not exceed the weekly total

supported.coachNote: Give a filled example budget first, then blank.

llm.tutorBrief: Help them add correctly. Do not shame spending. Keep examples modest and realistic.
llm.personalizeTemplate:
Pace={{pace}}. Local currency={{local_context}}.
Replace 500 units with a realistic local weekly amount. Keep correctOptionId values.
